_comment: Photos of herongnss.org. A page asks for one slot with <!--PHOTO:name--> or for a list with <!--GALLERY:name-->. 'source' is the original (repo-relative); website/tools/prepare_photos.py writes a clean web copy to website/src/img/photos/web/<file> (upright, resized, no GPS or other metadata). A slot with no 'file' shows a labelled placeholder with a review marker, so the site does not deploy without it. 'caption' shows under a gallery photo; 'credit' shows on the photo.

fig-fresnel-scale.alt: First Fresnel zone ellipses for altitudes from 20 m to 200 m and for elevations from 20 to 90 degrees, with a 10 m scale bar
fig-fresnel-scale.caption: First Fresnel zone at L5 (λ = 25.5 cm) to scale. Left: at 30° elevation, from 20 m to 200 m altitude. Right: at 150 ft altitude, from 90° to 20° elevation.

fig-bistatic.alt: HERON bistatic geometry: direct and reflected paths from a satellite to the drone over water
fig-bistatic.caption: HERON's bistatic geometry: the reflected path is longer than the direct path by about 2h sin e.

fig-conops.alt: Concept of operations in six steps: plan, set up, launch, survey and record, land and offload, process and verify
fig-conops.caption: Concept of operations: plan → set up → launch → survey & record → land & offload → process & verify.

fig-fish.alt: Block diagram of the FISH payload on the Aurelia X6 and the ground station
fig-fish.caption: The FISH payload: zenith RHCP and nadir RHCP+LHCP antennas, two B200 and two B210 SDRs on one clock board, an Intel NUC and a SATA SSD.

fig-system.alt: HERON system block diagram: aircraft, payload, ground station and post-processing
fig-system.caption: The whole HERON system: aircraft, FISH payload, ground station and post-processing.

res-overview.alt: Collect 171756: specular-point tracks, reflected-phase height against RTK, and reflected power by delay for G09, E05 and C12
res-overview.caption: Collect 171756 (hover at 118.6 m): specular-point tracks for GPS G09, Galileo E05 and BeiDou C12; reflected carrier-phase height against RTK; and reflected power by delay, with the reflection at lag 0 and direct-signal leakage below it.

res-altimetry.alt: Reflected-phase altimetry against RTK with RMS differences of 5.0 to 5.1 cm
res-altimetry.caption: Reflected-phase altimetry against RTK: the three satellites agree with each other and follow the RTK height with 5.0–5.1 cm RMS difference.

res-fresnel.alt: First Fresnel zone of G09 every 2 s, coloured by phase height minus RTK
res-fresnel.caption: The measurement footprint: G09's first Fresnel zone (27 m × 15 m) every 2 s during the hover.

res-coherence.alt: Phase coherence kappa and circular length R on the specular track for three satellites
res-coherence.caption: Water shows as coherence: median κ 0.82–0.89 and circular length R 0.93–0.96 over open water.

res-water.alt: Reflected C/N0 along the survey legs against the water fraction of the first Fresnel zone
res-water.caption: Water detection on the survey flight (172251): reflected C/N0 against the water fraction of each first Fresnel zone.

res-shoreline.alt: Survey legs over the shoreline on the drone ortho-photo, with C/N0 against FFZ water fraction for three outlines
res-shoreline.caption: Which shoreline explains the reflected power? With the team's own survey outline, the correlation rises to 0.56–0.65.

res-bank.alt: Ground height on the specular tracks from lidar, from the reflected phase, and their difference
res-bank.caption: Bank topography from the reflected phase against lidar: for GPS G09, 2.4 cm RMS and correlation 0.998 over 822 epochs.

res-nav.alt: Positions from GPS L5, BeiDou B2a and Galileo E5a against the autopilot RTK, C/N0 and sky plot
res-nav.caption: Positioning from the recorded direct signal: GPS L5, BeiDou B2a and Galileo E5a fixes within about 2 m of the autopilot RTK.

team-group.alt: The HERON team standing behind the drone on the launch mat at the flying field, 16 November 2026

fig-rack.alt: Render of the FISH payload rack with the right wall removed, showing the SDR boards in their rail strips
fig-rack.caption: The FISH rack (Fusion 360 render, one wall removed): the SDRs slide into rail strips.

fig-footprint-scale.alt: A CYGNSS footprint of about one kilometre over a lake, with an inset of HERON's 10 by 19 metre Fresnel zones crossing a shoreline
fig-footprint-scale.caption: Footprint scale: a spaceborne CYGNSS reflection covers about 0.9 × 1.8 km at 30° elevation. HERON's first Fresnel zone at 150 ft is 9.7 × 19.3 m, small enough to resolve a shoreline.

res-crossing.alt: Specular-point tracks of G09, E05 and C12 crossing the shoreline, the measured minus modelled path, and reflected power by delay for each satellite
res-crossing.caption: Survey flight 172251: as each specular point crosses the shoreline, the reflection fades over land and returns over water, for GPS, Galileo and BeiDou alike.

res-g09-phase.alt: GPS G09 raw residual phase, path change, coherence and reflected C/N0 against time, with land periods shaded
res-g09-phase.caption: GPS G09 on the survey flight: over water the reflected phase is steady and coherent (R and κ near 1); over land (shaded) it winds and the coherence drops.

res-g09-ffz.alt: First Fresnel zones of G09 every 2 s along the survey legs, coloured by the water fraction of each zone
res-g09-ffz.caption: Where G09's reflection meets the shoreline: its 24 m × 14 m first Fresnel zone every 2 s, coloured by how much of it lies on water.
